title: Spiderman and Marilyn at McDonald's
description: In a surreal green field, Spiderman stands on the left while Marilyn Monroe holds a Big Mac and a glowing aura emanates from her white dress. A large pile of McDonald's french fries and Chicken McNuggets spills across the grass in front of them. In the background stands a rustic wooden barn with a large yellow McDonald's logo on its side, under a dreamy sky filled with floating blue orbs and a glowing central orb with swirling metallic ribbons.
